fact: On 17 December 2024 the Ministry of Security and Civil Protection inaugurated the criminal intelligence analysis unit (ANACRIM) of the Centre d'Information Policière du Togo at Adidogomé, Lomé, under the SIPAO programme, which the text says is sponsored by the European Union under the ECOWAS Commission and implemented by INTERPOL, with the computer equipment, analysis software and premises provided; it says nothing of entry at commissariats or brigades.
title: RENFORCEMENT DU DISPOSITIF SECURITAIRE AU TOGO
publisher: Ministère de la Sécurité et de la Protection civile
